pr_title: lighting: lightning configuration tidb.tls = false should not affect cluster certificate (PD's connection)
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #54172

Problem Summary:
Based on the issue, my suggestion to fix the problem is to treat the `d.Security` and `d.TLS` settings separately in the `DBStore.adjust` function. Specifically, the `d.Security` setting should not be modified by the `d.TLS` value, so that even if the `d.TLS` setting is `false`, the cluster certificate (`s.CAPath`, `s.CertPath`, `s.KeyPath`, etc.) is Security to be set to `d.Security`. This ensures that the TLS setting for the TiDB connection does not affect the cluster certificate setting.

issue_context.title: lightning configuration `tidb.tls = false` should not affect cluster certificate (PD's connection)
issue_context.body:
When user only set `security` and not set `tidb.security`, TiDB connection's certificate will fallback to cluster certificate. However, TiDB connection has a separate `tidb.tls` to control other TLS behaviours. We should not let it affects cluster certificate, like in the case when fallack TiDB has `tidb-tls = false` but PD needs TLS

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/f57d2b9d379b188e46b187bf28db7ce30e67f0d5/pkg/lightning/config/config.go#L177-L179
comments:
I have a question.
What behavior would you expect for the following input?
```
{
    [security]
    [tidb]
    tls = "false"
    [tidb.security]
    ca-path = "/path/to/ca2.pem"
}
```
There is an error in the test at `TestAdjstSecuritySection`. What should I do?
```bash
~/workspace/tidb/pkg/lightning/config$ go test
--- FAIL: TestAdjustSecuritySection (0.00s)
    config_test.go:474: 
                Error Trace:    /home/sugimoto_e/workspace/tidb/pkg/lightning/config/config_test.go:474
                Error:          Not equal: 
                                expected: ""
                                actual  : "/path/to/ca2.pem"
                            
                                Diff:
                                --- Expected
                                +++ Actual
                                @@ -1 +1 @@
                                -
                                +/path/to/ca2.pem
                Test:           TestAdjustSecuritySection
                Messages:       input = 
                                                                [security]
                                                                [tidb]
                                                                tls = "false"
                                                                [tidb.security]
                                                                ca-path = "/path/to/ca2.pem"
```

> What behavior would you expect for the following input?

The expected behaviour is lightning doesn't use TLS to connect to TiDB.

> There is an error in the test at TestAdjstSecuritySection. What should I do?

The test is a bit confusing, it checks two fields `CAPath` and `TLSConfig`. The final goal is don't use TLS when `tls = false`, so we need to understand how the two fields take effect when dealing with TLS. Maybe we don't need to check `CAPath` in tests, or `CAPath` must be set to empty to disable TLS so the unit test asserts it (I forget which one is true). When you write the PR you can check the logic and change necessary test code.

review_comments: We should keep them. Because the real effective object is `TLSConfig`, and it's built from these fields in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/761b5926a73d15ef165f525fdada5a0f7fa3e221/lightning/pkg/server/lightning.go#L394 and https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/761b5926a73d15ef165f525fdada5a0f7fa3e221/lightning/pkg/server/lightning.go#L503, while this `adjust` is called at https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/761b5926a73d15ef165f525fdada5a0f7fa3e221/lightning/pkg/server/lightning.go#L355 which is before `run`. So only assigning `Security.TLSConfig` to `nil` is not enough, because `BuildTLSConfig` will re-create the `TLSConfig`

@lance6716 Thanks for the review.
I was mistaken. I should have discussed this issue before I started working on it.
I have two questions.
Is TLS always enabled for connections to PD?
Do we need to add a CAPath property dedicated to connections to TiDB to solve this problem?

> Is TLS always enabled for connections to PD?

it's controlled by `[security]` section in configuration file

> Do we need to add a CAPath property dedicated to connections to TiDB to solve this problem?

We already have it, it's `[tidb.security]`. And when `[tidb.security]` is not set, the fallback value is `[security]`. The original issue is related to `tidb.tls` configuration which will modify the behaviour of `[tidb.security]`. But when fallback happens, the old implementation will let it affect `[security]` because `[tidb.security]` is a reference to `[security]`. We don't want that.

https://docs.pingcap.com/tidb/stable/tidb-lightning-configuration
can you also add a unit test to check `security.ca-path` (`cfg.Security`) is unchanged? The new unit test should fail with the old code and should pass with this new PR.
